results.title: What are UX Surveys? — updated 2026 | IxDF
results.content: UX surveys, or user experience surveys are tools that gather information about users' feelings, thoughts and behaviors related to a product or service. Surveys are typically a set of questions and can cover a range of topics, depending on the purpose of the research. Designers or researchers analyze survey results to better understand how users interact with a system, application or website and work to improve it. When UX researchers or designers gather feedback as qualitative research data and quantitative research data from many participants, they can gain valuable insights. From there, designers can fine-tune user interface Design?") (UI) elements and more to create a better user experience and a high level of user satisfaction, and so help to win loyal customers. For example, when a brand takes user feedback and the insights it reveals, it can come out with new features that users of their existing mobile app are more likely to appreciate or a better visual design all around.
